prompt:

Asset type: standalone background-only illustration for a 2D armwrestling game, landscape exact 16:9 canvas, ideally 2560x1440.
Input images: Image 1 (existing brunette in cream turtleneck) is a drawing-style reference ONLY; Image 2 (existing game pub background) is a composition/game-layer reference ONLY.
Primary request: a charming unmistakably English London setting for the brunette female opponent, an Englishwoman. Draw ONLY the environment, no foreground character or arms or competition table. A cozy English riverside pub terrace overlooking Westminster and the Thames, prominent clearly recognizable Big Ben clock tower and Houses of Parliament in the LEFT THIRD of the upper half (left of the central opponent's face), warm light on sandstone gothic details, large clear clock face. Red British telephone box and a small red double-decker bus visible on the RIGHT side, subtle Union Jack bunting along upper corners, dark Victorian iron railing, brick pub wall at an outer edge, English tea cup and teapot on a SMALL distant side counter at the FAR RIGHT. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn illustrated game environment, clean dark brown outlines, warm painterly/cel shaded planes and restrained textures consistent with supplied reference game art. Architectural rendering simplified enough to read at game size, no photorealism, no 3D.
Composition/framing: straight-on view across the terrace, horizon around 45 percent of height. Upper central 35 percent must remain uncluttered (soft sky and distant river), to support a separately layered woman's head and torso at x=640,y=300 in a 1280x720 game. Big Ben fully visible above the game's foreground table, situated at x around 240, tower top around y=80 and base around y=350 in logical 1280x720 coordinates. Lower 35 percent is quiet terrace floor/low dark railing in muted colors, because the game overlays its own table and player's arms. Background fills entire canvas, opaque.
Constraints: background ONLY; zero people, zero characters, zero animals, zero foreground hands/arms, zero armwrestling tables/pads/pegs, zero UI overlays, no Russian bar signs, no text/captions/watermarks. No collage. Do not render the reference woman; she is a separate existing sprite.
